title: Financial orientation
gate: Reconcile money, returns, leverage and objectives. Introduce the safety briefing and journal immediately.

title: How markets and accounts work
gate: Trace a trade, choose orders and calculate realistic costs/cash needs.

title: Probability, statistics and core mathematics
gate: Solve uncertain-payoff problems; learn algebra/calculus entry skills. Defer specialist numerical/PDE extensions.

title: Underlying, macro, events and time series
gate: Separate information, expectation and hindsight; build elementary forecasts.

title: Price behavior and technical-analysis literacy
gate: Label unseen data and test one chosen method; keep most named patterns/indicators as reference material.

title: Options and local-market operations
gate: Decode contracts and pass exercise/settlement cases. Complete the selected jurisdiction branch; survey others.

title: Pricing and primary Greeks
gate: Derive replication/parity/binomial logic and calculate risk in correct units. Defer full stochastic derivations.

title: Realized and implied volatility
gate: Match forecasts to priced risks; distinguish IV ranking, expectation and risk premium.

title: Risk, funding, operational control and behavior
gate: Pass sizing, stress, cash-obligation and error-containment gates before implementing strategies.

title: Strategy construction and surface literacy
gate: Complete signed-leg dossiers; learn surface/term structure before multi-expiry valuation.

title: Execution and position management
gate: Reconcile fills and evaluate hold/close/adjust/roll policies with all cash flows.

title: Research, software, systems and performance
gate: Build a reproducible study, honest backtest, written system and complete journal analysis. Python basics can be introduced earlier.

title: Dynamic hedging, futures and portfolio risk
gate: Explain hedged P&L, distinguish futures/VIX products and stress a portfolio.

title: Advanced trading and empirical specialization
gate: Defend relative-value, dealer-flow and systematic-model hypotheses under realistic costs and alternative explanations.

title: Professional quantitative models
gate: Complete stochastic-calculus derivations, numerical validation and surface/model calibration for a quant track.

title: Cross-asset, exotic and OTC specialist branches
gate: Master the conventions and model/legal risks relevant to the selected product mandate.

title: Failure analysis and professional integration
gate: Pass integrated capstones, incident drills and a skeptical review of a desk-style mandate.
